I could not run or type-check it, since the library isn't here. Things I'm not sure of:

- **Fast key behaviour:** The notes don't say whether `fastKeys` multiplies the per-frame velocity increment, which would give 20× displacement while held. I assumed so.
- **Disposer:** I assumed its returned function removes all listeners and per-frame work, as the spec asks. The notes don't confirm this.
